summary.text: Kim Wilson is an unaffiliated candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 47B in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has served on the Woodbury City Council for the past six years and is running as an independent conservative.

paragraphs.text: Kim Wilson said in a Ballotpedia survey that she graduated from Woodbury High School in 1985.
She said she has served residents and businesses as a member of the Woodbury City Council for the past six years.
Wilson described her candidacy as that of an independent conservative whose first responsibility is to the people of Woodbury rather than a political party.
Her listed policy interests are government accountability, academic excellence, safe communities and schools, protecting homeownership, and protecting water quality and natural resources.
